blocks.text: Computing systems play a part in every aspect of our lives, so their legal and ethical side matters. This chapter covers terms of use, privacy and security threats, the digital divide, using information responsibly, computing's impact on society, and digital citizenship. Legal issues include data protection, intellectual property and compliance with laws; ethical issues include privacy, fairness and technology's wider effects.

blocks.title: Terms of Use
blocks.text: Terms of Use, also called Terms and Conditions or Terms of Service, are legal agreements set by a provider (a website, app or software company) that the user must accept. They set out how a service may be used and aim for a fair, transparent relationship in which both sides know their rights and obligations.

Signing up for Gmail means agreeing to Google's terms on how the account may be used, what may not be shared and how personal data are handled. A Pakistani shopping platform such as Daraz includes clauses on payment methods, returns and delivery.
